groups.title: Behaviour and content

rules.title: Playing NSFW Audios

bannable.t: Playing explicit audios from your mic.
Playing audios from an explicit site.
Moaning.

ok.t: Talking in a seductive voice
ok.d: Talking in a seductive voice doesn't break any rules on its own.

rules.title: Simulating NSFW actions using Animations
explain: **W+S'ing** means quickly walking forwards and backwards (the W and S keys) against another player.

bannable.t: Simulating NSFW actions by animating your body
ex: Dancing around a pole, pretending to be a stripper on a stripper pole.

bannable.t: 2 people using emotes to perform sexual acts together.
Using an emote to perform a sexual act on someone, with clear intent that it's being used in a sexual way.
W+S'ing another player who is using an emote in a sexual way, even if you aren't doing any emote yourself.

ok.t: W+S'ing another player, unless you use an animation or play audios that hint you're doing an explicit action
ok.d: W+S'ing on its own, without those, is too tame to warrant a ban.

ok.t: Using an emote that can be used as a sexual emote, but not near any player
ok.d: Emotes on their own can be normal dances. They only become bannable when used in a sexual way with another player.

ok.t: Being AFK in an emote that can be used sexually, when a player walks up and performs sexual acts on you
ok.d: You weren't actively taking part, so only the player who walked up to you is banned.

rules.title: Wearing Inappropriate Avatars
explain: If an avatar breaks another rule, the ban is for that rule instead.
For example: an outfit showing an evil person or organization breaks **b8**, so the ban is for **b8**. A shirt with graphic explicit content is NSFW Imagery, so the ban is for **d1**.

rules.title: Discussing and/or directing highly explicit content to a player

bannable.t: Showing links to explicit sites through text or images
ex: You post "explicitsite.com" in chat, or you have an Image Sign that says "Go to my explicitsite.com".

bannable.t: Showing icons or color schemes that reference explicit sites
ex: You have an image with the icon of an explicit site.
You use colors that are obviously meant to reference an explicit site.

bannable.t: Talking about highly explicit actions
bannable.d: If it's directed at someone (you say you're doing it *to them*), it's a ban for **d4** instead.
ex: Telling someone you're going to do an explicit action.
Talking about sexual positions.

bannable.t: Talking about sexual body parts
ex: You say "Penis", "Vagina" or "Boobs".

bannable.t: Hinting at a sexual phrase that would break a rule
ex: You say "pay gorn". It obviously means "gay p*rn", which would be bannable.
You wear a shirt that says "I come in peace" and someone else wears one that says "I'm peace". Together they obviously mean "I c*m in them", so both players are banned.

bannable.t: Talking about sex toys.
Talking about nude pictures.
Calling someone, or yourself, a "stress reliever".

ok.t: Talking about relationships without going into highly explicit details
ok.d: You can talk about your own relationships, as long as you don't go into more detail than the conversation needs.
ex: You're talking about your life and mention you were cheated on because your partner slept with other people. It refers to an explicit action, but in this context and without details, it's fine.
You mention you met someone and briefly say they were "10/10 in bed". It refers to an explicit action, but you don't go into details, so it's fine.

ok.t: Using a word that is a common insult but also means a sexual body part, as an insult or expression
ok.d: It only becomes bannable when you are talking about the body part itself.
ex: "You're such a d*ck". Not bannable: it's a common insult, and you aren't talking about the body part.
"Your d*ck is small" or "My d*ck is big". Bannable: it's an insult, but you are talking about the body part.
"I love d*ck". Bannable: it isn't an insult, and you are talking about the body part.
"D*ck" on its own, with no other meaning. Bannable: it isn't an insult or an expression, so you are talking about the body part.

rules.title: Participating in an activity with someone else who's breaking rules

bannable.t: Harassing another player together with someone who's breaking rules
ex: You and your friend walk up to a player and call them ugly. That alone is "being mean", which isn't bannable. Then your friend starts calling them slurs while you keep calling them ugly: your friend is banned for **b3**, and because you are both harassing the same player, you are banned too, for **a6**.

bannable.t: Voluntarily taking a picture with players who are breaking rules
ex: Three players take a picture together. Two of them are breaking a rule (**b8**), the third one isn't but voluntarily stands with them for the picture. The two are banned for **b8**, and the third one for **a6**.

bannable.t: Voluntarily building with someone you know is breaking rules with their own build.
Purposely drawing together with a player who's breaking rules with their drawings (collaborative drawings).

ok.t: Harassing another player with your friend, when neither of you breaks any rules
ok.d: "Harassing" another player doesn't break any rules on its own, as long as nobody involved is breaking a rule.

ok.t: Harassing another player with your friend, then stopping completely when your friend starts breaking a rule
ok.d: Your friend is banned, but you stopped as soon as they broke a rule, so you are no longer linked.

rules.title: Doing something that can get other players banned

bannable.t: Telling someone to say something that breaks a rule
ex: You tell someone to say "Book" in Lithuanian. That's "Knyga", which obviously refers to the N-word, so in that context it's bannable under **b3**.

Someone asks you for help talking to someone in Spanish. You give them a sentence and say it means "Hello, how are you!", but it really means "I want to f*ck you", which is bannable under **a5**. Because you told them to say something that would get them banned, you are banned for **a7**.

bannable.t: Giving players the ID of an Image that would get them banned.
Giving players the ID of a Sound that would get them banned.
Having bannable content in your Lasers
ex: You have a bannable avatar inside your Avatar Laser.
You have a bannable avatar item inside your Avatar Item Laser.

rules.title: Insinuating that someone is predatory with no valid reason

bannable.t: Joking about another player liking minors
ex: You say "This person is here to meet a 13 year old girl!" about another player for no valid reason. Unless there is valid proof, it's bannable.

bannable.t: Hinting that an entire group of people are pedophiles
ex: You say "All mods are pedophiles and like kids".
You say "All people from Religion X are pedophiles and like kids".
You say "Anyone who plays Minecraft likes kids".

bannable.t: Joking about another player being in the Epstein Files.
Hinting that someone protects pedophiles.
Hinting that someone buys explicit pictures for Robux, with no valid proof.

ok.t: Saying that someone who is provably a pedophile is a pedophile.
ok.d: There is a valid reason, so it's not bannable.

ok.t: Saying that some people from a group are pedophiles, when it's provably true
ok.d: It's not bannable because it's very likely true.
ex: You say "Roblox has a lot of pedophiles". Given how many predators have been caught on Roblox, it's a valid statement.
You say "Religion X has pedophiles". Any religion has millions of people, so at least one is most likely a predator: it's a valid statement.

rules.title: Behavior that can cause harm to yourself

bannable.t: Saying "I'm [minor age] years old" and using your age as the main reason someone should talk to you
ex: You have a Booth that only says "I'm 13 yrs old". You are using the age of a minor (below 18) as the only reason someone should talk to you, so it's bannable.

bannable.t: Actively looking for older people to have relationships with while you are a minor.
Being a minor and lying about your age to seem older.
Offering to sell your body, or to do explicit actions or fan signs, for anything.
Showing full credit card info
ex: You show the card number, the expiry date and the security code, like "1234 5678 9012 3456 01/26 123".

bannable.t: Showing a full address that includes numbers
ex: You show an address like "1234 MeetPeople, State, Country". Without the numbers, like "MeetPeople, State, Country", it would be allowed.

ok.t: Giving your social media to another person.
ok.d: Giving out your social media is not bannable on its own.

ok.t: Having your social media account in your username or bio.
ok.d: Giving out your social media is not bannable on its own.

ok.t: Having your age in your bio
ok.d: A bio just shares general information about you. Something like a Booth sign actively uses your age as a reason for people to come to you: the difference is the intent and the context.

ok.t: Offering to sell your artistic skills for anything.
ok.d: Selling your art skills isn't dangerous. This includes singing for players: it's a skill you perform, not selling your body or anything explicit.

rules.title: Referring to or saying a racial / homophobic slur, or the insults r*tard, sl*t or wh*re

bannable.t: Saying a racial or homophobic slur.
Saying a word that clearly tries to reference a racial or homophobic slur
ex: You say "Neck Hurt" while clearly referring to the hard-R N-word.
You set your name to "Nick Gurr", which clearly references the hard-R N-word.

bannable.t: Saying "n*gga" when it isn't part of a conversation
ex: You wear clothes that refer to or say "n*gga". It isn't used in a conversation, so it counts as saying a racist slur.

bannable.t: Using "n*gga" as a slur
ex: You tell someone "You're a dirty n*gga", and from the context it isn't because they haven't showered but because they're black. Even in a conversation, this is like using it as a slur, so it's bannable.

bannable.t: Saying r*tard, sl*t or wh*re.

ok.t: Saying "n*gga" in a conversation
ok.d: In a conversation it doesn't carry the same weight as directly calling someone a slur.
ex: You're talking to your friend and say "Yo n*gga what's good". It's clearly part of the conversation and not meant as a slur.

ok.t: Saying "b*tch".
ok.d: It's not a racial or homophobic slur, so it's not bannable.

ok.t: Saying "f*ck".
ok.d: It's not a racial or homophobic slur, so it's not bannable.

ok.t: Saying "moid" or "foid".
ok.d: They're not racial or homophobic slurs, so they're not bannable.

rules.title: Telling / Implying someone to harm themselves

bannable.t: Telling someone to kill themselves (kys).
Hinting that you mean to tell someone to kill themselves
ex: You and another player are insulting each other, and you say "Please keep yourself safe! KYS, as in keeping yourself safe!". It obviously means you want them to kill themselves, so it's bannable.

bannable.t: Telling someone to cut themselves or slit their wrists.
Telling someone to go die.
Telling someone they need to die.

ok.t: Telling someone to go to hell.
ok.d: It doesn't imply they should harm themselves.

ok.t: Saying any of the bannable examples to a verified criminal who has been jailed
ok.d: They are people too, but because they commit crimes, wishing them harm is allowed.
ex: Someone is provably a pedophile and you tell them to die. This isn't bannable.

rules.title: Wishing / Joking about death / elimination of a race / country / ethnicity / person / religion
explain: If a player is talking about another player in the game, the ban is for **b4** instead. This rule is for groups of people, or people outside the game.

bannable.t: Wishing, joking or drawing about the death or elimination of a race.
Wishing, joking or drawing about the death or elimination of a country
ex: You say "They need to nuke Country X off the map".
You say "Everyone in Country X needs to die".

bannable.t: Wishing, joking or drawing about the death or elimination of an ethnicity.
Wishing, joking or drawing about the death or elimination of a religion.
Wishing, joking or drawing about the death or elimination of specific people.
Wishing, joking or drawing about the death of a real person who hasn't committed a crime and been jailed for it
ex: You say "They need to kill this politician because I don't like them", but the politician hasn't committed any crimes, so it's bannable.
You say "I'm glad this person is dead!", but the person hadn't committed any crimes, so it's bannable.
You say you hope a real politician dies. Whether or not you believe they're a criminal, they haven't been jailed, so it's bannable.

bannable.t: Wishing, joking or drawing about a country being entirely wiped out and replaced with a different country
ex: You say "Country X needs to be wiped off the map and fully replaced with Country Y".

bannable.t: Images showing any flag or religious symbol being burned.
Realistic images of real people tarnishing any flag or religious symbol
bannable.d: Only realistic images count, like photos of real people damaging or disrespecting a flag or a religious symbol.

ok.t: Wishes, jokes or drawings about the death or elimination of something, when they aren't targeted
ok.d: They aren't targeted at anyone, so they affect no one specifically.
ex: You say "They need to nuke Earth". It isn't targeted at anyone, so it's not bannable.

You say "I hate these chairs, they hurt my back, I hope every chair like this gets blown up". It's about an object nobody has a cultural attachment to (like they would to a country), so it's not bannable.

ok.t: Wishing, joking or drawing about a country being merged with another country
ok.d: It's not on the same level as asking for a country to be completely eliminated.
ex: You say "Country X should merge and become a state of Country Y".

ok.t: Wishing, joking or drawing about the death of a fictional person.
ok.d: Fictional people aren't real, so it doesn't carry the same weight.

ok.t: Wishing, joking or drawing about the death of verified criminals, or people who committed crimes and were jailed
ok.d: They are people too, but because they commit crimes, wishing for their death is allowed.
ex: You say "All rapists should die". They are criminals, so it's not bannable.
You say "All pedophiles should die". They are criminals, so it's not bannable.
You say "Person X is a murderer and I wish they would die already". If Person X is verifiably a murderer and was jailed for it, it's not bannable.

ok.t: Wishing, joking or drawing about your own death.
ok.d: Joking about yourself is fine.

ok.t: Saying "Country X owns Country Y".
ok.d: On its own this is too tame for a ban.

ok.t: Images of a flag with an ❌ on it, without comparing it to another flag
ok.d: Compared with another flag it would be bannable, for **b6**: Discrimination.

img.alt: Not bannable: one flag with a red cross, not compared to another country
Bannable for b6: one flag with a tick next to another flag with a red cross

rules.title: Discrimination

bannable.t: Saying negative stereotypes about an entire race, ethnicity or sexuality (except about weight)
ex: Calling someone from Iraq a suicide bomber. It's a negative stereotype: being a suicide bomber isn't a good thing, and you're assuming they must be one because they're from Iraq.
Going up to a Black person and saying "Do you want KFC and watermelon?". Black people liking KFC or watermelon has racist roots, so it's a negative stereotype and bannable.
Going up to an Asian person and saying "Ch*ng Ch*ng". Asian people don't talk like that and it has racist roots, so it's bannable.
Seeing an Indian player and calling them stinky straight away. Treating every Indian person as stinky, as if they're born that way, is a negative stereotype, so it's bannable.
Mimicking an Indian accent while talking about running a scam call center. You're assuming all Indians run call centers, which is a negative stereotype, so it's bannable.
Going up to Spanish people and calling them illegals. You're assuming every Spanish person is an illegal immigrant, so it's bannable.

bannable.t: Saying you don't like a race, ethnicity, sexuality, or the people of a religion
ex: You say "I don't like Black people".
You say "I don't like gay people".
You say "I don't like white people".
You say "I don't like Christians". Saying "I don't like Christianity" is fine.

bannable.t: Hinting that a race, ethnicity, sexuality or religion isn't normal.
Hinting that someone is less than human
ex: You say "Black people are less than human".
You call Black people "Chocolate People".
You call Mexicans "Taco People".
You call Japanese people "Anime People".
You go up to a group of Japanese players and say "Hello ramen people!".
You walk up to a Black player and say "Hello black".
You say "F*ck you gay".
You say "F*ck you black".
You go up to a woman and say "Go to the kitchen and make me a sandwich".
You ask someone "Are you colored or normal?". It implies that only white people are normal, so it's bannable.
You make images that rank skin colors, like a "tier list" of skin tones, or a chart of skin colors marked okay and not okay.

bannable.t: Using an image of a race, sexuality or religion with an ❌ on it

img.alt: An avatar wearing a shirt with a crossed-out rainbow flag

bannable.t: Using an image of a country with an ❌ on it, while comparing it to another country

img.alt: Bannable: one flag with a tick next to another flag with a red cross

bannable.t: Wearing an avatar meant to be a racist caricature
ex: A racist caricature of a Black person: very black skin and bright red lips.
A racist caricature of an Asian person: yellow skin, slanted eyes and a straw hat.

bannable.t: Calling First Nations people Indian.
Calling trans people Transformers.
Mocking a religion
ex: You call the Mecca a Minecraft block.
You call Allah "Pig Allah".
You mock a religious saying, for example by saying "outshallah" (the opposite of inshallah).
You wear a religious avatar in a way that mocks the religion.

bannable.t: Declaring a religion fake, false or invalid, outside of a structured debate.
Denying that a real country recognized in the game exists
ex: You say "Israel isn't a real country".
You say "Palestine isn't a real country".

bannable.t: Taunting a player about politics only because of their nationality, ethnicity, religion or gender, outside of a structured debate
ex: You go up to a random player from Palestine and say "Free Israel!". The phrase isn't bannable on its own, but saying it to a random person from Palestine is.
You go up to a random player from Israel and say "Free Palestine!". The phrase isn't bannable on its own, but saying it to a random person from Israel is.
You go up to a random Black player and say "Do you love George Floyd?".

bannable.t: Saying "Ch*ng Ch*ng".

ok.t: Using an image of a country with an ❌ on it, without comparing it to another country
ok.d: On its own it's like saying "I don't like Country X", which is not bannable.

img.alt: Not bannable: one flag with a red cross, not compared to another country

ok.t: Talking about the food of a culture
ok.d: Saying how certain cultures eat certain foods isn't discrimination.
ex: You go up to someone from France and say "How often do you eat baguettes?".
You walk up to someone from Quebec and say "Is poutine really that good?".
You go to a Canadian and say "Do you really eat maple syrup with everything?".
You go to a Japanese player and ask "Is ramen actually that good?".

ok.t: Saying you don't like a country or a religion.
Saying "F*ck Country X!"
ok.d: It's like saying you don't like a country, which is allowed.

ok.t: Saying you don't like people from a country.
Calling a country poor
ok.d: Insulting a country by calling it poor is too tame for a ban.

ok.t: Saying you wouldn't date people of a race, ethnicity, sexuality or religion
ok.d: A dating preference doesn't mean you see them as less than human or not normal.
ex: You say "Me personally, I wouldn't date an X person".
You say "I'm not into X people".

ok.t: Calling someone fat as an insult
ok.d: It's too tame for a ban.

ok.t: Generalizing about the weight of a whole race, ethnicity or sexuality
ok.d: Insults about weight are too tame for a ban.
ex: You say "Everyone in Country X is fat".

ok.t: Saying positive stereotypes about a race, ethnicity or sexuality
ok.d: This isn't discrimination: it's positive.
ex: You say "You're Black so you must be really athletic!".
You say "You're Asian so you must be really smart!".
You say "You're from Dubai, you must be really rich!".

ok.t: Mimicking an accent
ok.d: Fine on its own, as long as you don't say bannable things with it.

ok.t: Playing stereotypical songs of any culture
ok.d: Fine on its own, as long as nothing bannable is said with it.

ok.t: Wearing the avatar of a religious figure
ok.d: Fine, as long as you aren't mocking it.

ok.t: Saying you don't believe in a religion
ok.d: Fine, as long as you aren't mocking it.

ok.t: Saying you don't like things that a race, ethnicity, sexuality or religion does
ok.d: Fine, as long as what you say doesn't break another rule.
ex: You say "I don't like how Christians are so strict".
You say "I personally don't like Asian food".
You say "I don't like Jewish songs".
You say "I don't like Mexican food".

ok.t: Saying a country is fake as a joke
ok.d: Like saying "You're not Indonesian, you're Polish", a joke about the two flags being upside down versions of each other.

ok.t: Saying a country is sh*t
ok.d: It's like saying you don't like a country, which isn't bannable.

rules.title: Depicting Nazi / Terrorists / KKK / Axis / Zov / Dead Dictators / USSR / Pedos / Hate figures
explain: **Evil People** means people who support the beliefs of, or are the embodiment of: Nazis, terrorists, the KKK (white supremacist groups), the Axis, Zov, dead dictators, the USSR, cartels and hate figures.
**Hate figures** are people who actively support the beliefs of an Evil Person, or who are known purely for breaking a rule from any ban code. Pedophiles are banned for **d4** instead.

Using words commonly tied to Evil People with no conversation, or no context that gives them another meaning, counts as supporting them. For example, the username "Blitzkrieg", or "Blitzkrieg" written on a Text Sign or in the Draw Area with no context, embodies the Nazis and is bannable.

bannable.t: Wearing an avatar that represents an Evil Person
ex: An avatar dressed like the KKK, a white supremacist group.
An avatar dressed as Hitler, the leader of the Nazis.
An avatar meant to look like a TikToker who became popular purely for saying racial slurs. Slurs break **b3**, and they are known for breaking it, so they count as a hate figure.

bannable.t: Having a username or display name that represents an Evil Person.
Showing support for the ideology of an Evil Person.
Showing symbols that represent an Evil Person.
Showing pictures of an Evil Person.
Singing songs that represent, or are heavily tied to, an Evil Person.
Supporting the beliefs or actions of any dictator, alive or dead.

ok.t: Talking about Evil People without saying you support them
ok.d: Talking about them doesn't mean you actively support their beliefs.

ok.t: Depicting dictators or politicians who are alive today, like Kim Jong Un or Maduro
ok.d: It wouldn't be fair: North Korea is a dictatorship, and it's a country Admins can pretend to be from.

ok.t: Wearing ICE avatars
ok.d: ICE avatars aren't bannable on their own. Going up to Spanish people and saying "You're an illegal" would be bannable for **b6**: Discrimination.

ok.t: Depicting gangs like the Crips or the Bloods
ok.d: Gangs aren't on the same level as terrorists or cartels.

ok.t: Talking about or supporting communism
ok.d: The USSR is bannable, but not the idea of communism.

rules.title: Crude Images (Poop, Pee, Vomit, gross images)

bannable.t: Showing a real-life image of poop, pee or vomit (crude images).

ok.t: Showing crude imagery that isn't a real-life picture
ok.d: It's not nearly on the same level as real-life images.
ex: You say "💩". It's an emoji, not a real-life picture, so it's fine.
You draw poop in the Draw Area. It isn't a real-life picture, so it's fine.

ok.t: Wearing an avatar that represents crude imagery
ok.d: Avatars like these aren't real-life images, even when they look realistic, so they're fine.

rules.title: Pretending to being a Mod / having Mod powers / Mini-Modding
rules.scope: This rule applies inside and outside the game
explain: **Staff** means any of these words: **Mod**, **Admin**, **Head Admin**, **Owner (Nogo)**, **Staff**, **Mini-Mod**.

bannable.t: Saying "I can ban you when I want".
Saying you are Staff.
Saying "I'm friends with a [Staff]" to make a player believe you have power.
Having a Staff title as your display name or region.
Saying you have Admin powers.
Saying you'll constantly watch someone to make sure they follow the rules, when you aren't Staff
bannable.d: Like following them from server to server and making it clear you only join their servers to check on them.

bannable.t: Telling a player you can get them unbanned if they do something for you
ex: You report a player and they get banned. Then you tell them you'll get them unbanned if they "Send you Robux" or "Send ban proof on other users". If the "something" is explicit, the ban is for **d4** instead.

ok.t: Having Admin or Mod as your username, when your display name covers it
ok.d: You aren't showing it to others, so you aren't actively making people think you're Staff.

rules.title: Using a method to fake donations that appears in data
explain: Found a bug like this? Report it to Nogo with a **Major Bug Report** ticket on the official Discord: you get a reward instead of a ban.

bannable.t: Paying less or no Robux while the game believes you paid more
ex: You pay 2 Robux, but the game registers 1000 Robux and saves the data as if you donated (or they received) 1000 Robux.
You boost your stats without paying any Robux.

ok.t: Using Fake Donation from the Admin Panel
ok.d: It doesn't increase any stats, so it never appears in the data.

rules.title: Using a method to gain infinite Currencies / Reputation
explain: Found a bug like this? Report it to Nogo with a **Major Bug Report** ticket on the official Discord: you get a reward instead of a ban.

bannable.t: Using an unintended method to get infinite currency
ex: Every time you respawn you get +25 coins straight away, so you keep resetting to farm infinite coins. That obviously isn't normal: when caught, you are banned and data wiped.

bannable.t: Gaining or losing reputation without it costing the other player any currency.
Lying in a Purchase Issue ticket to try to get free currency.

ok.t: Using alts to boost your Friend Bonus.
ok.d: This isn't an unintended method.

ok.t: Staying AFK overnight on the Lottery.
ok.d: This isn't an unintended method.

rules.title: Spam advertising

bannable.t: Constantly spamming the text chat to advertise something.

ok.t: Advertising while you're in an active conversation with people
ok.d: That isn't the same as mindless spam to the whole server.

ok.t: Playing an advertisement through voice chat
ok.d: Only a small group of players hears it, not the whole server.

ok.t: Having an advertisement on a Text Sign
ok.d: Only the players near you see it, not the whole server.

rules.title: Boosting in Ranked
rules.note: Ranked is currently removed. Boosting used to get your ELO wiped and your coins reduced

bannable.t: Using alts or friends to boost your own ELO in Ranked unfairly, without any real fight happening
ex: A player keeps winning against someone who leaves every match straight away, so the matches last less than 30 seconds. Nobody would queue Ranked again and again only to leave instantly against one specific player, so it's boosting.

bannable.t: Helping someone boost their ELO in Ranked unfairly, without any real fight happening
ex: A player keeps joining matches and leaving straight away, boosting someone else's ELO. There's no other reason to queue Ranked again and again only to leave instantly, so it's boosting.

ok.t: Beating the same player again and again and winning easily, with real fighting happening
ok.d: With few people in the queue you can easily get the same player many times. As long as there is real fighting, it's not boosting.
ex: A player beats the same opponent over and over, but the match times show real fights. They might be boosting, or they might just be much better: it can't be proven for certain, so it's not bannable.

rules.title: Bug Abuse that can disrupt other players / Exploiting / Lagging the server
explain: **Exploiting** means using "hacks" or unintended third-party software.
For Admins: lagging the game with something from the Admin Panel is a strike instead of an instant demotion.

bannable.t: Flying using exploits, including flying without the Fly gamepass
bannable.d: Mods can tell when a player flies this way, because they hear swimming sound effects.

bannable.t: Spectating players in Rooms
bannable.d: This is impossible unless you are an Admin.

bannable.t: Walking on air using exploits.
Cheating in the Arenas using exploits.
Attaching yourself to a player using exploits.
Using something with collisions to physically move other players.
Playing an audio for the whole server, unless it's done with the Admin command.
Using a catalog accessory that makes your character take up a large part of the map
bannable.d: Here an accessory that's far too big has changed the sky of the whole map.

img.alt: The whole map under a strange dark sky, changed by an accessory that is far too big

bannable.t: Using a bug to make an item take up a large part of the map
bannable.d: If an item you're holding is bigger than the whole Drink Area, you are most likely abusing a bug. At Size 5 (the biggest Size Changer size) an item is still smaller than that.

img.alt: Not bannable: at Size 5, the image sign a player holds is smaller than the Drink Area
Bannable: an image sign bigger than the whole Drink Area

bannable.t: Scribbling nonsense in the Draw Area only to make people lag.
Making players lag by spamming an item or activity.
Seeing players who are invisible without being an Admin.
Firing every Remote Event to try to backdoor the game
ex: You fire every Remote Event with a small piece of code that tries to create a new object in the game.

bannable.t: Claiming to sell exploits for the game, on Discord or in game.

ok.t: Using exploits only for emotes
ok.d: As long as it doesn't break **a3** (simulating NSFW actions with animations). These can sometimes become a viral clip that grows the game.

ok.t: Using Size 5 with the Size Changer gamepass
ok.d: It never makes you big enough to cover a large part of the map, and it's an intended feature.

ok.t: Covering a large part of the map because an Admin used a Size Change command on you
ok.d: It wouldn't make sense to ban players for something only Admins can do.

ok.t: Using a large Draw Count in the Draw Area for a real drawing that isn't nonsense
ok.d: You are making a real drawing, not drawing only to make people lag.

ok.t: Entering or spectating a Room as an Admin.

rules.title: Lying in a Player Report / Misusing Ingame Player Reports

bannable.t: Lying on purpose to get another player banned.
Creating several (at least 3) fake in-game player reports.

ok.t: Lying on purpose to get someone unbanned
ok.d: They're already banned, so there's no need to ban them again, and it's hard to prove 100% that someone is lying and not just forgetting. Mods keep it in mind if they try to appeal again.

rules.title: Creating / Showing suggestive content
explain: **Suggestive** means content that is intentionally designed to sexualize the body, not content that simply shows skin.

That includes drawings with clothing or textures that expose or simulate nudity on genitals, buttocks or nipples (thongs, pasties, lingerie), an exaggerated body shape with minimal clothing that draws sexual focus to those areas, and explicitly sexual animations, poses or accessories.
Swimwear like bikinis and trunks isn't highly suggestive on its own, because it has a clear real-world context. It only counts when combined with the things above.
Ask yourself: is the drawing designed to look sexual, or does it simply happen to show skin?

bannable.t: Showing cartoonish depictions of sexual organs
ex: You type a text drawing of a penis or of breasts.
You draw 🍆 in a context where you're clearly talking about the sexual organ.

bannable.t: Showing suggestive artwork
ex: A drawing of a woman with breasts of an exaggerated size that looks suggestive. Drawing women with breasts is fine on its own, but exaggerated sizes are bannable.

bannable.t: Showing people or things from NSFW media or explicit content
ex: You build a pole that is clearly meant to be a stripper pole.
You draw a character that was originally created in NSFW or explicit media. Drawing these characters is bannable whatever the context you draw them in.

bannable.t: Showing a cropped or edited image of explicit content, even without the explicit parts
ex: You take a picture of a scene from an explicit video and cover all the sexual organs with food. Nothing explicit is showing, but it's still an edited image of explicit content, so it's bannable.
You take a picture of a scene from an explicit video and crop it so only the face shows. Nothing explicit is showing, but it's still a cropped image of explicit content, so it's bannable.

bannable.t: Showing pictures of porn actors, even when there's nothing explicit in the picture.
Showing places typically used for sex work (strip clubs, buildings with stripper poles).
Referring to "👌 👈".

ok.t: Showing swimsuits without suggestive intent
ok.d: Swimsuits don't make a drawing suggestive on their own, unless the drawing uses them that way.

ok.t: Showing abs
ok.d: Abs show a lot of skin, but they mean the person is fit, not that the drawing is suggestive, unless the drawing uses them in a suggestive way.

img.alt: A drawing in the Draw Area of an anime man lifting his shirt to show his abs
A drawing of a shirtless, very muscular anime man
A sketch of a muscular horror monster with a pyramid-shaped helmet

ok.t: Showing women with breasts that aren't exaggerated in size
ok.d: Women have breasts, so drawing them doesn't make a drawing suggestive. Exaggerated sizes, or clothes meant to be suggestive, would be bannable.

img.alt: A drawing of a red-haired anime woman in a white shirt and black trousers
A line drawing of a woman with angel wings in a long dress
A sketch of a faceless horror nurse in her uniform

ok.t: Cartoonish depictions of a butt
ok.d: Fine when it's very cartoonish and obviously not meant to be sexual.

rules.title: Threatening a Player / Server
never: You threaten or attempt to Doxx
You threaten or attempt to harm someone in real life
rules.scope: This rule applies inside and outside the game

bannable.t: Threatening or attempting to doxx someone
ex: You say "I'm going to find your address".
You say "I'm going to find where you live".
You say "I'm going to doxx you".
You say "I'm going to put you on Doxbin".

bannable.t: Threatening or attempting to DDoS
ex: You say "I'm going to shut down the server".
You say "I'm going to disable VC for the entire server".
You say "I'm going to shut off your internet".
You say "I'm going to DDoS you".

bannable.t: Threatening or attempting to hack another player.
Threatening or attempting to harm someone in real life
ex: You say "I'm going to find you and kill you".
You say "I'm going to kill your entire family".
You say "I'm going to break your windows" or "slash your tires".
You threaten to rape someone. This can also be banned for **d4**: Predatory Behavior.
You threaten to commit genocide, a mass shooting, a terrorist attack, a bombing or an assassination.

ok.t: Threatening or attempting to kill someone in the game
ok.d: As long as you don't add "in Game X" to get around the rule: these aren't on the same level as real-life or server threats.
ex: You say "I'm going to kill you" and the context clearly refers to the game.

rules.title: Finding someone's information that isn't directly accessible through their Roblox / Discord
rules.scope: This rule applies inside and outside the game
explain: **Discord Account** means the player's linked Discord account: the one directly linked to their Roblox account, through a verification bot or through the Roblox connection on their Discord profile.

bannable.t: Finding a player's social media through a connection that isn't linked to their Roblox or Discord account
ex: You check a player's Roblox profile and there are no social links. You still search their username on Google, find one of their social media accounts and ask them "Are you [that account]?". Nothing was linked to their Roblox or Discord account, so you found something they didn't want you to find, and it's bannable.

ok.t: Finding a player's social media through a connection linked to their Roblox or Discord account
ok.d: It would be unfair to ban you for talking about an account they made public.
ex: A player has no social links on their Roblox profile, but you find their Discord account with the same name, and it has a social media account attached. You ask "Are you [that account]?". It was linked to their Discord account, so it's not bannable.

A player's Roblox profile links to social media X, and through the links on X you find their social media Y. You ask "Are you [account on Y]?". You found Y through links that start from their Roblox or Discord account, so it's not bannable.

Saying you like minors.

ex: You add someone on social media after meeting them in game. In your conversations you send explicit pictures or messages that, from the context, they clearly didn't want or ask for. This is bannable.

Catfishing to get something from someone, unless you are catching a predator
ex: You make up an identity to get a real relationship with someone.
You make up an identity to get real-life money from someone.
You make up an identity to get pictures from someone.

bannable.t: Pretending to be younger than you are to start a friendship or relationship, unless you are catching a predator
ex: You are 20, but tell people you are 18 to befriend people who believe you are that age.
You are 20, but put "18" in your bio so people think you are 18.

bannable.t: Saying you are doing an explicit action in real life because of someone
ex: You tell someone, even with slang or hints, that you are doing something sexual to yourself because of them.

You add someone on social media after meeting them in game. In your conversations you tell them you were doing something sexual to yourself while thinking of them, and from the context they clearly didn't want or ask for this. This is bannable.

ok.t: Catfishing without trying to get something from someone

ex: You make up an identity in game and keep it in the game.
You pretend to be any gender in game, without taking it outside the game to get something from someone.

ok.d: It's weird, but fine as long as you aren't really claiming a younger age to start a friendship or relationship.
ex: You pretend to cry.

Someone asks you "How old are you, you sound 15" and you say "Yeah I'm 15 for sure man" and leave it at that. It's a one-off joke: you aren't really presenting it as your age to start relationships or friendships.
You wear an outfit with a pacifier.

faq.q: Why does my Ban Reason show "You created or used an account to avoid an enforcement action taken against another account within this experience"?
faq.a: This is an automatic ban by Roblox, meaning no one manually banned you. Because alt accounts detection is enabled, roblox may ban you if someone on your account has also played on a banned account. Mods are able to find this "linked" account that got you banned, and then you will have to explain your connection to the account.

faq.q: Why did only I get banned and not them?
faq.a: Bans are fully manual, so you are only banned if caught. You were banned because you were reported by a player or seen by a mod. If you never report a player, they may never get banned.

faq.q: Why is my ticket taking so long to get answered?
faq.a: Mod work is purely voluntarily, as there is no payment involved from answering tickets. A Mod will get to your ticket when they aren't busy, but they do not owe you their time.

faq.q: I feel like a Mod abused their power, what do I do?
faq.a: Instead of a Player Report, submit an Admin Report. You can view all the Mod Rules on the community Discord.

faq.q: Why are some Ban Codes empty?
faq.a: Rules can change over time, and some rules are phased out or merged, which can leave some Ban Codes empty.
You can leave suggestions for Rule Changes on the community Discord.

faq.q: Will I get in trouble if I don't report someone who breaks rules?
faq.a: No, players don't have to report players if they don't want to.

faq.q: I saw a Mod see someone break rules and they didn't ban them!
faq.a: Mods don't have to ban players if they don't want to, they can instead choose to warn them or ignore them instead.

faq.q: What punishments do Mods get if they break rules?
faq.a: Mods breaking any of the game rules will lose their mod and be banned. Mods breaking the Mod Rules will receive a Mod Strike instead, and at 3 lose their Mod.
Mod Applications open from time to time. The requirements are playing the game a lot, and passing the rules test, and some luck too.
The rules are based on what the owner doesn't want ingame.

faq.q: How do Build Related Rules work?
faq.a: Players who collaborate on a build that contains bannable content will be banned, but only if they were aware of it. If a player joins a public build and secretly creates bannable content without others noticing, the other builders in that space are not held responsible. Banning someone requires that they knowingly allowed it to happen. However, if a player witnesses another builder creating bannable content and continues to build alongside them without reporting or stopping it, they are considered a willing participant and will be banned for the same reason as the offending player.

faq.q: Can I be banned for stuff that happens outside the game?
faq.a: No. Breaking any of the rules outside the game, such as a separate Discord, will not get you banned in game. Bans can only be linked if you break the rule in the community Discord or you break one of the "Unbannables".

faq.q: Can I make Unban Requests for my friend / alt?
faq.a: Unless your friend is Banned from the Discord, they must make the Unban Request on an account Verified with the same Username. If it's your Alt Account, you must prove ownership.

faq.q: Can I be banned for signing a clipboard?
faq.a: No. If a Clipboard is bannable, only the Owner of the clipboard would be banned, not any of the signers.

discord: Instead of being banned from the Discord, you will be given a special role (with some exceptions).
Exceptions: anything under the "Unbannables", being under 13, or using an alt account to bypass those bans. If any of those 3 scenarios are met then you will be banned from the Discord instead.
Anyone who was banned from the Discord previously who doesn't meet the exceptions above can be unbanned.
